theme: A quiet day at sea, one committee call, and a weekend of moving parts ahead.
greeting: You're mid-charter in the Adriatic, Dan, with an open day but for the NACD committee call. The warm thread this morning is Brunswick—Lauren has your CV moving through recruitment—while the real work is the runway home: Saturday's disembark and Sunday's Florida landing still have loose ends.

needsAttention.title: Croatia disembark still has open ends
needsAttention.detail: Saturday's Cavtat transfer from Komolac, the midday bag hold, and the early Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight all need arranging from shore—and signal aboard is thin, so it's worth doing while you have it.

needsAttention.title: No Florida car or St Pete beds for Sunday
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sept 20 at 3:55; the Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV and the two St Pete nights (Sept 20–21) before the Orlando villa are both still unbooked.

schedule.title: NACD New England Programming Committee
schedule.detail: Zoom with Larissa Ravetto's committee—7 PM your time, if the boat's signal holds.

flagged.title: Brunswick is circulating your resume
flagged.detail: Lauren Nadig passed your CV to recruitment and to Courtney in New York, and will send names as soon as she has them.

flagged.title: New Garmin sign-in flagged
flagged.detail: A sign-in from a new location—consistent with you connecting Navionics from Croatia, so likely your own.

flagged.title: Two FICO balance alerts
flagged.detail: Routine myFICO notices that a reported account balance went down; nothing to act on.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and receipts—NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, ICGN, Yale alumni, and airline and carrier notices.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply this morning.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Early autumn's first apples are at their peak—a rustic free-form galette lets them shine.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas SUV rental (refundable, PWM)

acts.line: Open water and nothing on the calendar—the morning is yours before the one call.
A single fixed point: the committee Zoom at 1, landing at 7 PM where you are.
The charter's last full evening aboard before Saturday's return to land.
